description: This file contains a set of shell script tests for the `git rebase --abort` functionality, including setup, various scenarios of aborting rebase, and checks for correct behavior.

methods.name: check_head
methods.description: Verifies that the current HEAD is at 'pre-rebase' and the current branch is 'to-rebase'.

methods.name: testrebase
methods.description: Performs a series of tests to verify the behavior of 'git rebase --abort' under various conditions, including after --skip, --continue, and when checking out tags.
